<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="390" height="844" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="150%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="4" flood-color="#DCDCDC" flood-opacity="0.65"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F3F2F7"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="24" fill="#110053"/>
  <text x="20" y="16" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">9:41</text>
  <line x1="329" y1="16" x2="332" y2="16" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="335" y1="14" x2="338" y2="14" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="341" y1="12" x2="344" y2="12" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2"/>
  <circle cx="356" cy="13" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  <line x1="353" y1="17" x2="359" y2="17" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <rect x="368" y="8" width="16" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="1.2"/>
  <rect x="370" y="10" width="11" height="6" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <rect x="385" y="11" width="2" height="4" rx="1" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

  <!-- Header -->
  <rect x="0" y="24" width="390" height="88" fill="#110053"/>
  <polyline points="31,66 22,73 31,80" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <line x1="23" y1="73" x2="42" y2="73" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2.4" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <text x="56" y="79" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="21px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Agregar acompañante</text>

  <!-- Main content -->
  <text x="24" y="148" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="19px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Datos del acompañante</text>
  <text x="24" y="175" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Ingresa los datos tal como aparecen en su</text>
  <text x="24" y="195" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">documento de identidad.</text>

  <!-- Personal details card -->
  <rect x="18" y="218" width="354" height="385" rx="14" fill="#DCDCDC" opacity="0.55"/>
  <rect x="18" y="216" width="354" height="385" rx="14" fill="#FFFFFF" filter="url(#shadow)"/>

  <!-- Name field -->
  <text x="34" y="251" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Nombre completo</text>
  <rect x="34" y="263" width="322" height="52" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="50" y="295" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#1C1B1F">Valentina Rojas Morales</text>
  <line x1="337" y1="282" x2="347" y2="292" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="347" y1="292" x2="337" y2="302" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.5"/>

  <!-- ID type and number -->
  <text x="34" y="347" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Documento de identidad</text>
  <rect x="34" y="359" width="114" height="52" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="49" y="391" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#1C1B1F">Cédula</text>
  <polyline points="127,381 132,386 137,381" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>

  <rect x="158" y="359" width="198" height="52" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="174" y="391" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#1C1B1F">1.023.456.789</text>

  <!-- Date field -->
  <text x="34" y="443" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="700" fill="#110053">Fecha de nacimiento</text>
  <rect x="34" y="455" width="322" height="52" rx="7" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#B6B6B6" stroke-width="1"/>
  <text x="50" y="487" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="16px" font-weight="400" fill="#1C1B1F">14 / 08 / 1992</text>
  <rect x="324" y="469" width="18" height="17" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  <line x1="328" y1="466" x2="328" y2="472" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  <line x1="338" y1="466" x2="338" y2="472" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.3"/>
  <line x1="324" y1="475" x2="342" y2="475" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.2"/>

  <!-- Helper note -->
  <circle cx="43" cy="548" r="9" fill="#4658E0"/>
  <text x="40" y="552" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">i</text>
  <text x="61" y="545" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Estos datos serán utilizados para gestionar</text>
  <text x="61" y="563" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">sus reservas y documentos de viaje.</text>

  <!-- Save companion checkbox -->
  <rect x="24" y="630" width="18" height="18" rx="3" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <polyline points="28,639 32,643 39,635" fill="none" stroke="#1B0188" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
  <text x="53" y="644" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="14px" font-weight="600" fill="#1C1B1F">Guardar como acompañante frecuente</text>

  <!-- Primary action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="24" y="678" width="342" height="51" rx="7" fill="#EA104C"/>
    <text x="195" y="710" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="17px" font-weight="700" fill="#FFFFFF">Agregar</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom navigation -->
  <rect x="0" y="760" width="390" height="84" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <line x1="0" y1="760" x2="390" y2="760" stroke="#E0E0E2" stroke-width="1"/>

  <!-- Inicio -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="39,784 49,776 59,784" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <rect x="42" y="783" width="14" height="12" rx="1" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <text x="49" y="817" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Inicio</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Viajes -->
  <g>
    <rect x="118" y="778" width="19" height="14" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="121" y1="783" x2="134" y2="783" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="123" y1="775" x2="123" y2="781" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <line x1="132" y1="775" x2="132" y2="781" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="127" y="817" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Viajes</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Buscar -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="204" cy="783" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8"/>
    <line x1="210" y1="789" x2="216" y2="795" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="204" y="817" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Buscar</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Beneficios -->
  <g>
    <polygon points="282,776 285,782 292,783 287,788 288,795 282,792 276,795 277,788 272,783 279,782" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <text x="282" y="817" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Beneficios</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Cuenta -->
  <g>
    <circle cx="350" cy="780" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <ellipse cx="350" cy="792" rx="10" ry="6" fill="none" stroke="#5C5C5C" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <text x="350" y="817" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Nunito Sans" font-size="11px" font-weight="400" fill="#5C5C5C">Cuenta</text>
  </g>
</svg>
